name: Badlands & Black Hills
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is best for both parks, though early August brings the Sturgis Motorcycle Rally and its several-hundred-thousand riders; winter is cold with limited services.
overview: Badlands' eroded rock, bison at Custer State Park, Rushmore and Crazy Horse — plus one of the world's largest motorcycle rallies.
costOverview: Genuinely affordable by national-park standards — aside from Sturgis Rally week, when lodging prices spike hard across the whole region.

specialSeasons.text: The Sturgis Motorcycle Rally (early August) brings several hundred thousand riders to the Black Hills — the region's single busiest, most transformed week of the year.
